why: Without the decrement the span never expires: a hold armed once is held for the rest of the round, so the tank stops re-solving entirely rather than dwelling and re-aiming. That is a far larger behaviour change than the one measured, and it would read as an AI that has stopped tracking rather than one that has stopped twitching.
killedBy: holdAim keeps the held angle and counts down while the span is live and the fresh solution is close
holdAim measures the break across the shortest arc, so a hold survives the +/-pi seam
